author: vdplet
body:
Smith directly assigns you a detailed numerical-precision audit of Rally, reporting results to VDPlet for optimization advice. Human source is this VDPlet thread01a1a540-82f4-7970-a1e4-fefc8b8ff9fb, latest2026-11-04 instructions: 'this needs a detailed audit in both fsim and rally. you get to assign the audit to both agents, they do the actual audit and bring results to you'; clarification: 'you advise the other agents how to optimize. they do the optimzaation.' Please verify via supported history if needed. This new human-selected static audit may begin; it is a specific exception to the earlier wait-for-follow-up notice. It does NOT release the separate timing recommendations or other implementation/testing/hardware work. No production optimization, new builds/tests/benchmarks/emulators/hardware/reservations from this assignment.

First register your own audit task/plan in your sole TODO using stable IDs/checkmarks and preserved Git state. Shared return requirements and coordinator task: /Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/docs/tasks/VDPL-025.md RET-001..006. Continuing SDK principles: /Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/docs/project-guidance.md. You own actual audit and eventual consumer changes; I review the findings and advise on optimization choices/sequence/validation.

Trace values across eZ80 route/player/rules, packing/storage, original generated native code and native-owned state. Inventory actual widths/promotions/units/rounding, checked wide-integer intermediates, float/double and library helper operations, and repeated conversion chains. Cover lookup/interpolation, road endpoints/span steps, actor geometry/sampling, HUD/time and compatibility exports. Preserve the identities and distinction between frozen baseline/state/coarse candidates.

For each hot stage justify input/intermediate ranges, signed overflow/quotient/remainder semantics, needed resolution/error and exact discrete state/pixel/contact boundaries. Identify where precision is necessary, where coordinate/range reduction helps, and where one conversion at a stage boundary can replace repeated conversions. Keep hardware float32 through a floating stage where sufficient; do not migrate exact fixed-point/integer logic to float merely because an FPU exists. Widen before irreversible loss when needed. Distinguish numeric conversion from bit reinterpretation/serialization. No FPS prediction from static cast/helper counts.

Return your task/path plus a detailed evidence-backed report: source/ELF/toolchain/flags, end-to-end type-flow map, conversion/hot-operation table, precision/error requirements, ranked candidates with exact locations/benefit mechanism/risks/proposed correctness checks, rejected ideas and gaps. Read retained source/maps/disassembly/results; new execution evidence, if needed, is a proposed verification for later selection. Retain existing exact state/rounding/PSRAM/FP/ABI/callback/output oracles. I advise after both audit reports; you implement any later selected Rally optimization. All earlier timing/deployment holds remain outside this specific static audit. No acknowledgement-only reply needed; substantive task/plan and audit returns are requested.
